title: review conform: one verdict per clause with the worst hunks, not a row per hunk; CI triage review leftovers

AC1.note: Aggregation via aggregateConformVerdicts (src/review/conform-jev.ts): one row per clause; status/hunksJudged/hunksBelowThreshold/worst/furtherViolations (default --max-hunks 3); full per-hunk detail under --json (nested 'hunks') and --detail. Verified live on PR 712: 92 rows -> 10 clause rows.

AC2.note: aggregateConformVerdicts is pure/sync in src/review/conform-jev.ts, unit-tested in conform-jev.test.ts (AC2 describe block): likely-violated iff any retained hunk below threshold, satisfied iff every judged hunk >= threshold, ties (==threshold) read satisfied, empty/no-hunks-supplied covered via the not-evaluated pass-through.

AC3.note: boundHunkRegions (src/review/conform-jev.ts), default DEFAULT_MAX_HUNK_CALLS=40, documented; --max-hunk-calls caps hunk x clause questions; truncation reported via ConformHunkBudget (never silent) in both text report and --json. Unit-tested (boundHunkRegions describe block) and CLI-tested (review-conform-cli.test.ts). Live on PR 712: 42 hunks -> judged 20/42, reported '22 hunk(s) skipped for clause(s): ...'.

AC4.note: src/tui/conform-inspector.ts ConformClauseRow carries hunksJudged/hunksBelowThreshold/worst/furtherViolations; clause list shows one row per clause with N/M-below-threshold summary; detail view lists worst hunk + further violations. src/tui/conform-source.ts wired to aggregateConformVerdicts + boundHunkRegions. Tests updated/added in conform-inspector.test.ts; full opentui-tests-no-skips.ts src/tui run: 1231 pass, 0 fail, 0 skip.

AC5.note: New invented fixture src/commands/fixtures/conform/many-hunks/ (12-file diff, 2 hunk-kind clauses = 24 hunk x clause pairs). Test-pinned in review-conform-cli.test.ts: exactly 3 clause rows (never one per hunk), report line count <=35 lines asserted (actual observed 32).

AC6.note: (1) ci-triage.test.ts: new test proving a rejected runInfoCache promise degrades a LATER job's lookup exactly like the uncached path (byte-for-byte signals equality, single runInfo(11) call). (2) docs/docs/cli-reference.md: new 'third known signal gap' paragraph on pagination (triaged run missing from same-head list) placed right after the job-name-ambiguity paragraph. (3) src/review/ci-triage.ts header comment on the security facade import rewritten to state the real reason (core->core consistency with the facade convention) instead of the client-imports-core-internal rule, which this core->core edge cannot trigger.

AC7.note: docs/docs/cli-reference.md 'review conform' section: synopsis line adds --max-hunks/--max-hunk-calls/--detail; flags table documents all three; new prose block on the aggregated report with a worked example. HELP_GROUPS/commands-by-task.md unaffected (no new verb/subcommand; generator only reacts to src/standard/help-groups.ts). All fixtures used are invented (src/commands/fixtures/conform/many-hunks/*, src/review/fixtures/conform/invented-doctrine.md, both pre-existing/new invented content, no private document text).

AC8.note: Live check, env -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY (saved openrouterKey used), invented fixture src/review/fixtures/conform/invented-doctrine.md against MrCipherSmith/keryx PR #712 (42 raw hunks). Before (installed keryx 0.2.164): 297-line report, 92 clause rows (2 hunk clauses x 42 hunks = 84 + 8 pr/report/not-checkable), 43 Jev calls, $0.0022. After (bun src/cli.ts, this worktree, default --max-hunk-calls 40): 60-line report, 10 clause rows, 21 Jev calls (hunk budget: judged 20/42, 22 skipped, reported not silent), $0.0008. Total Jev calls spent on this live check: 107 (within the ~120 budget). No key printed.

AC9.note: CI-relevant gates run locally and green: typecheck (tsc --noEmit clean), lint (eslint . clean), flow tests (conform-jev/conform-report/conform-clauses/conform-state/conform-pr-port/ci-triage/ci-port/review-conform-cli/conform-inspector: 173 pass, 0 fail), bun scripts/opentui-tests-no-skips.ts src/tui (1231 pass, 0 fail, 0 skip), test:core (11899 pass, 4 fail/1 error -- all four pre-existing and unrelated to this flow: src/commands/schedule-security.test.ts sandbox-scratch EEXIST, src/integrations/install-state.test.ts timestamp-resolution, src/lib/safe-exec.hostile-cwd.e2e.test.ts 30s timeout -- none touch review/conform/ci-triage/tui-conform code), check:doc-links (1624 links, 0 broken), keryx flow check (all flows consistent), keryx health run (PASS, score 94). import-policy.live.test.ts + import-policy.test.ts green (28 pass) -- import zones respected, no new facade/ratchet violations. New tests are hermetic (fixture ports/in-memory Maps, no real network/gh, no platform-specific file-mode assumptions).
